payout_quote: Online $200 cash rewards bonus after making at least $1,000 in purchases in the first 90 days of your account opening
steps: Open the official Bank of America student card page and read the offer terms plus the interest-rates-and-fees summary.
Apply online for the Bank of America Customized Cash Rewards Credit Card for Students (students only); a hard credit inquiry is part of the application.
If approved, make at least $1,000 in purchases (not balance transfers or cash advances) within the first 90 days of account opening — only spending you already planned.
Pay the statement balance in full each month so no interest accrues.
Collect the $200 online cash rewards bonus once the spend requirement is met.
catches: Never spend extra solely to earn the bonus — only count the $1,000 of purchases you were already going to make; manufacturing spend defeats the purpose.
No annual fee ($0), so the $200 bonus is yours to keep net if you meet the spend on planned purchases.
Applying triggers a hard inquiry on your credit report, which can temporarily lower your score.
Carried-balance interest erases the bonus: after the 0% intro APR (15 billing cycles), the variable APR is 17.49% to 27.49%, so always pay in full.
Students only — you must be a student to qualify for this version; the standard Customized Cash Rewards card (already verified as R0702) is the non-student equivalent.
biggest_catch: The $200 is only free money if the $1,000 is spending you already planned — never stretch your budget to chase it, and pay in full: the 17.49%-27.49% variable APR after the intro period will eat the bonus if you carry a balance.
eligibility: Students only; new cardholders; at least $1,000 in purchases within the first 90 days of account opening.
timing: Bonus is an online cash rewards bonus paid after the $1,000/90-day requirement is met; exact posting timing not stated on the page.
